from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific non-current asset line item extracted from the document."""
    description: str | None = Field(description="The line-item description (e.g. 'Real estate properties, net')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The raw numerical amount reported in the line item")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")

class CompanyFiling(BaseModel):
    """A company's financial filing containing asset information."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company (e.g. 'Broad Street Realty, Inc.')")
    non_current_assets: list[AssetItem] = Field(description="List of non-current asset line items found in this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class aggregating all companies found across the documents."""
    companies: list[CompanyFiling] = Field(description="List of company filings processed")
